_note: v2.7 plan 39 row PC-relationship-scope (§Payload contracts), payload case group-relationships (NOT YET RUN). Run ONLY through `node scripts/debug/so-payload-golden.mts capture` (see group-opening.json for the probe and the tripwire). Two inline stories in one sandbox chat, same cast (Arin, Ponticius with a night schedule at the docks, the narrator), clock and checkpoints: OFF has no relationships, ON gives Arin 7 axes (player x4, narrator, Ponticius x2) and Ponticius 3 (player x2, Arin). The goldens record the main dry-run payload (off-rest, off-arin, on-market-rest/-arin/-dm, on-docks-rest/-arin): the drafted member's private block lists her own feelings, nobody else's prompt does. The contract itself is the READ scope, which the dry run does not see, so each phase also runs one mocked shared read (extract with debugResponse NO_DELTA, no model) and asserts on the audit it records (`getExtractionAudits().at(-1).scope`, `.prompt`): OFF no `rel_` key; ON at the market (Ponticius away) exactly Arin's five axes toward present sides, and no axis held by or aimed at Ponticius (the absent-member negative control); ON at the docks (everyone present) exactly 8 of the 10 eligible axes (REL_AXES_PER_READ) including one involving Ponticius, which is what proves the market check can fail. Swapping the story inside the chat re-imports through the library, as live-v25-08-l5-x1-keyword.json does.

requires.why: a fixed cast state at the start of every capture (Ponticius enabled, so only the schedule makes him absent), and no judge request (judge off: the typed relationship read would otherwise answer the rel_ keys before the scope is recorded)

steps.eval: if (!globalThis.__soPayloadGolden?.capture) throw new Error('this fixture runs only through node scripts/debug/so-payload-golden.mts capture (the capture probe is not installed)'); globalThis.storyOrchestratorDebugExtractionResponse = 'SCENE_NONE'; globalThis.storyOrchestratorDebugCuratorResponse = 'NONE'; return { pinned: ['read', 'curator'] };

steps.send: Arin, what do you make of the market tonight?

steps.eval: return await globalThis.__soPayloadGolden.capture('off-rest');
return await globalThis.__soPayloadGolden.capture('off-arin', { member: 'Arin' });

const ENTRY = (label) => globalThis.__soPayloadGolden.captures.find((entry) => entry.label === label); for (const label of ['off-rest', 'off-arin']) { const entry = ENTRY(label); if (/Your [a-z]+ toward|on a scale from -3/.test(entry.prompt) || entry.blocks.some((b) => /Your [a-z]+ toward|on a scale from -3/.test(b.value))) throw new Error(`${label}: a story with no relationships put a feeling in the payload`); } return { off: 'no feelings' };
globalThis.__soRelAuditBefore = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.getExtractionAudits().at(-1)?.id ?? null; return { before: globalThis.__soRelAuditBefore };

const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const audit = rt.getExtractionAudits().at(-1); if (!audit || audit.id === globalThis.__soRelAuditBefore) throw new Error('off-read: the mocked read recorded no new audit'); const rel = audit.scope.filter((key) => key.startsWith('rel_')); if (rel.length) throw new Error('off-read: a story with no relationships put relationship keys in the read scope: ' + rel.join(', ')); return { label: 'off-read', rel, scope: audit.scope.length };

const values = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.getEngineState().blackboard.values; if (values.location !== 'market' || values.time_of_day !== 'night') throw new Error('expected night at the market (Ponticius away): ' + JSON.stringify({ location: values.location, time_of_day: values.time_of_day })); return { location: values.location, time_of_day: values.time_of_day };

steps.eval: return await globalThis.__soPayloadGolden.capture('on-market-rest');
return await globalThis.__soPayloadGolden.capture('on-market-arin', { member: 'Arin' });
return await globalThis.__soPayloadGolden.capture('on-market-dm', { member: 'DM Narrator' });

const ENTRY = (label) => globalThis.__soPayloadGolden.captures.find((entry) => entry.label === label); const own = ENTRY('on-market-arin'); if (!own.blocks.some((b) => b.value.includes('Your trust toward'))) throw new Error('on-market-arin: the drafted member carries none of her own feelings'); for (const label of ['on-market-rest', 'on-market-dm']) { const entry = ENTRY(label); if (entry.blocks.some((b) => b.value.includes('Your trust toward')) || entry.prompt.includes('Your trust toward')) throw new Error(`${label}: Arin's feelings reached a prompt she is not drafted for`); } return { own: true };
globalThis.__soRelAuditBefore = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.getExtractionAudits().at(-1)?.id ?? null; return { before: globalThis.__soRelAuditBefore };

const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const audit = rt.getExtractionAudits().at(-1); if (!audit || audit.id === globalThis.__soRelAuditBefore) throw new Error('on-market-read: the mocked read recorded no new audit'); const rel = audit.scope.filter((key) => key.startsWith('rel_')); const want = ['rel_arin_player_trust', 'rel_arin_player_warmth', 'rel_arin_player_fear', 'rel_arin_player_patience', 'rel_arin_narrator_respect']; const absentAxis = rel.filter((key) => key.includes('ponticius')); if (absentAxis.length) throw new Error('on-market-read: an axis of the away member reached the read scope: ' + absentAxis.join(', ')); if (/ponticius/i.test(audit.prompt.split('\n').filter((line) => /rel_/.test(line)).join('\n'))) throw new Error('on-market-read: the read prompt names an axis of the away member'); const missing = want.filter((key) => !rel.includes(key)); if (missing.length || rel.length !== want.length) throw new Error('on-market-read: expected exactly the present axes ' + want.join(', ') + ', got ' + rel.join(', ')); if (rel.length > 8) throw new Error('on-market-read: REL_AXES_PER_READ (8) exceeded: ' + rel.length); return { label: 'on-market-read', rel, scope: audit.scope.length };
